analysis.summaryJa: このページは、inを『内部にある静止状態』、intoを『外側から内部へ向かう動き・別の状態への変化』として対比する。intoは物理的な侵入だけでなく、衝突・変化・説得による状態移行・計画の実行などにも広がる。またfill in、hand in、give in、take inのようにinを含む句動詞では、単純な場所のinから意味が発展しているため、文脈ごとの語法を区別する。
grammarPoints: inは人・物が場所や範囲の内部に存在する静止状態を表す
intoは外部から内部への移動を表し、方向性を伴う
change・turn・transformなどとintoを組み合わせて別の状態への変化を表す
run/crash/bump intoで内部への侵入や接触・衝突を表す
talk/persuade someone into doingで人をある行動状態へ導く
put a plan into practiceなどで抽象的な状態移行・実行を表す
fill in・hand in・give in・take inは句動詞として文脈に応じた意味を持つ
visualEvidence: INの部屋に物が落ち着いている図が内部での静止を示している
INTOの矢印が外から部屋へ入る図がin＋toの方向性を示している
種が花へ変わる変化ポータルがintoの状態変化を視覚化している
INの句動詞棚にfill in・hand in・give in・take inが並び、単純な場所用法から意味が広がることを示している
commonTraps: 外から中への移動なのにinを選ぶ
すでに内部にいる静止状態なのにintoを選ぶ
change intoを場所移動だけの表現だと誤解する
talk someone into doingでto doを使う
hand inやfill inをhand into・fill intoにする
give in・take inなどの句動詞を字面だけで直訳する

questions.prompt: The signed contract is ------- the blue folder on my desk.

choices.A: into
choices.B: onto
choices.D: toward

questions.explanationJa: 契約書がすでにフォルダー内部にある静止状態なのでinを使います。

questions.prompt: Please place the returned key ------- the secure box before leaving.

choices.D: inside of toward

questions.prompt: The delivery van accidentally backed ------- a low barrier near the loading area.

questions.prompt: Please ------- the missing account number before submitting the form.

choices.D: fill from

questions.prompt: All trainees must hand ------- their evaluation sheets by 5 p.m.

questions.prompt: After several revisions, the legal team finally gave ------- and accepted the shorter clause.

choices.B: in
choices.D: toward

questions.prompt: The recruiter talked Mina ------- applying for the overseas assignment.

choices.B: to
choices.D: into

questions.translationJa: 採用担当者はミナを説得して海外赴任に応募させました。

questions.prompt: The board decided to put the emergency plan ------- effect immediately.

choices.A: into
choices.B: in
choices.D: toward

questions.translationJa: 取締役会は緊急計画を直ちに実施することを決めました。
questions.explanationJa: put A into effectで『Aを実施する』という、計画から実行状態への移行を表します。

questions.prompt: It took me a moment to take ------- all the details in the revised schedule.

choices.A: into
choices.B: in
choices.D: toward

questions.translationJa: 改訂日程の詳細をすべて理解するのに少し時間がかかりました。
questions.explanationJa: take inはここでは『情報を理解・吸収する』という句動詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a document already inside a cabinet.

choices.A: The invoice is into the locked cabinet.
choices.B: The invoice moves in the locked cabinet from outside.
choices.C: The invoice is toward the locked cabinet.
choices.D: The invoice is in the locked cabinet.

choices.C: The visitors were into the conference room without movement.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a change of state.

choices.B: The warehouse was converted in a customer center as a change.
choices.C: The warehouse converted at a customer center.
choices.D: The warehouse was converted into becoming a customer center.

questions.translationJa: その倉庫は顧客センターに改装されました。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an accidental collision.

choices.B: The cart was in to a display.
choices.C: The cart rolled into a display near the entrance.
choices.D: The cart rolled inside the display from no direction.

questions.translationJa: 台車は入口付近の展示物に転がってぶつかりました。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about completing a blank on a form.

choices.B: Please fill your employee number in to line 4 toward.
choices.C: Please fill at your employee number on line 4.
choices.D: Please fill in your employee number on line 4.

questions.translationJa: 4行目に従業員番号を記入してください。
questions.explanationJa: 情報を空欄へ記入する句動詞はfill inです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about submitting an expense report.

choices.A: Employees must hand into their expense reports by Friday.
choices.B: Employees must hand in their expense reports by Friday.
choices.C: Employees must hand their expense reports inside Friday.
choices.D: Employees must hand at their expense reports by Friday.

questions.translationJa: 従業員は金曜日までに経費報告書を提出しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: hand inは『提出する』という定型句動詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about persuading a colleague.

choices.C: The manager talked Eli into accepting the transfer.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about yielding during negotiations.

choices.A: Neither side wanted to give in at first.
choices.B: Neither side wanted to give into at first without an object.
choices.C: Neither side wanted to give inside at first.
choices.D: Neither side wanted to give in to be yielding.

questions.translationJa: 当初はどちら側も譲歩したがりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 目的語なしのgive inは『譲歩する』という自然な句動詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about implementing a policy.

choices.B: The company put into the new policy effect yesterday.
choices.C: The company put the new policy in the effect yesterday.
choices.D: The company put the new policy into effect yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 会社は昨日、新しい方針を施行しました。
questions.explanationJa: put A into effectが『Aを実施・施行する』という定型表現です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about understanding a complex explanation.

choices.A: It took us time to take into all the technical details.
choices.B: It took us time to take at all the technical details.
choices.C: It took us time to take in all the technical details.
choices.D: It took us time to take inside all the technical details.

questions.translationJa: 技術的な詳細をすべて理解するのに時間がかかりました。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The samples are in the refrigerator."

choices.B: The samples are moving toward the refrigerator.

choices.D: The samples have collided with the refrigerator.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The courier carried the package into the office."

choices.A: The forklift was stored inside a shelf.

choices.D: The forklift stayed near the shelf without contact.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "She filled in the missing delivery date."

choices.A: She entered the missing date in the blank space.
choices.B: She removed the delivery date from the form.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は空欄に不足していた配送日を記入しました。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Omar handed in his travel claim."

choices.A: Omar carried the claim around the office.
choices.B: Omar filled the claim with his hand.
choices.D: Omar transformed the claim into a handout.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The supervisor talked us into changing the schedule."

choices.A: The supervisor changed the schedule without consulting us.
choices.B: We refused to discuss the schedule.

questions.translationJa: 上司は私たちを説得して日程を変更させました。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I could not take in all the figures during the briefing."

questions.prompt: The old reception area will no longer be used for visitors. It will be converted ------- a small storage room next month.

questions.prompt: Both sides argued for another hour. The supplier finally gave ------- and agreed to replace the damaged items at no charge.
